title: PARDES MEIN ZAINAB KHO BAITHI
body:
PARDES MEIN ZAINAB KHO BAITHI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
ROTEY HAI KHADE SAB AALE NABI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
<<DIVIDER>>
ARMAAN NA NIKLA BANO KA
HAE LAASH PAH NAUHA BANO KA
PAYEGI KAHAN YEH KOOKH JALI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
<<DIVIDER>>
DIL THAAM KE AKBAR KI MAADAR
KEHTI HAE YEH SARWAR SE ROKAR
KHO AAYE KAHAN AYE IBNE ALI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
<<DIVIDER>>
NAAZON SE MURAADON SE PAALA
SHAADI KA ZAMANA JAB AAYA
MAIDAAN MEIN KHOKAR BAITH GAYI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
<<DIVIDER>>
SHABBIR SE KEHTI HAE ZAINAB
MUJH KO TOH BADA HAE ISKA TAA-AB
KYON MAINE LIYA THA TUMSE AQI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
<<DIVIDER>>
QISMAT KA KAROON MAIN KIS SE GILA
KHIDMATH KA EWAZ KUCH BHI NA MILA
SEHRA BHI NA ZAINAB BAANDH SAKI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
<<DIVIDER>>
KEHTE THAY YEH SHAHE KARBOBALA
TAQDEER MEIN YOONHI LIKHA THA
AB SABR KARO AYE BINTE ALI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
<<DIVIDER>>
SHOWKAT PAH QAYAMAT KA GHAM HAE
SHOWKAT YEH GHAZAB KA MAATAM HAE
BAALEEN PAH KHADE ROTEY HAIN NABI
ATHARA BARAS KE PAALE KO
